entries.title: Estimate material cost on a product
entries.description: Products now carry a material cost estimate you can build and maintain, and jobs show how their actual cost compares against it.

entries.title: Export completed jobs as a sales spreadsheet
entries.description: The job list has a download button that exports completed jobs, with their pricing and cost, as a CSV you can open in a spreadsheet.

entries.title: Filter the planning board by department
entries.description: The planning board can be narrowed to a single department so you only see the work that belongs to your team.

entries.title: Add the workshop department
entries.description: Workshop joins the existing departments, with its own icon, so quotes, jobs and bays can be assigned to it.

entries.title: Delete a bay added by mistake
entries.description: A bay that has never been used can now be deleted outright instead of only disabled, and a bay still referenced by scheduled or completed work explains what is holding it.

entries.title: Tidier job list and calendar
entries.description: The job calendar no longer crowds each day with job chips, and the job list keeps its export and create buttons together in the page header.

entries.title: Clearer job filter when booking a slot
entries.description: The Jobs shown filter now displays the readable option name instead of its underlying value.

entries.title: Clearer contact form errors
entries.description: Submitting the contact form with missing details now highlights each field that still needs an answer instead of silently doing nothing.

entries.title: Footer links land in the right place
entries.description: Clicking a footer link now takes you to the top of the destination page, and the Contact us link and language switch give immediate feedback when clicked.
